name: TransitFinance
fix_description: In _verifyPool, after computing poolSalt from token0/token1/fee, verify that the pool address matches the CREATE2-derived address from the legitimate factory: require(address(uint160(pool)) == computeAddress(factory, poolSalt, POOL_INIT_CODE_HASH)). Currently the function only checks that the pool returns matching token0/token1/fee but does not verify the pool was deployed by the real factory, allowing fake pools to pass validation.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short single-call exploit that abuses unsafe trust in user-supplied pool data by pointing the router to the attacker contract masquerading as a UniswapV3 pool. It requires minimal protocol knowledge, no flash loans or complex sequencing, and the PoC is well under 100 lines with only straightforward interface spoofing.
